learning_outcomes.text: To explain the principles of economic and financial considerations needed to be respected during the process of the new product development and technical processes management.
To provide students with knowledge of contemporary approaches to the management, economic and economical principles and techniques used in business.

syllabus_topics: Goals and rules of the course, basic economic functions and terms
Budgeting, cost types and cost examples related to specific resources in an industrial company
Introduction to costing, types of costing methods
Application of Hourly Cost Tariffs and Contribution Margin calculation
Introduction to Project management – basic terms, process of project planning, project management tools
Summary of the first part, links and interactions in the enterprise planning
Introductory to Financial Management
Financial statements
Financial statements analysis and interpretation
Working Capital Management
Sources of Finance
Capital Investment Appraisal
Business planning
Operation Budget Creation based on Activities. Assignment.
Operation Budget of Engineering Team - presentation. Debate on its key items.
Costing. HCT Method application – specific versions I. Relation to Target Costing Approach.
Costing. HCT Method application – specific versions II. Student cases presentations.
Financial Statements Analysis.
Working Capital Management
Assessment of Sources of Finance + Capital Investment Appraisal
